dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: If you're looking for the Master of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild, I regret to inform you that, that would be me.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: By which I mean, don't expect any help from me on Guild-related matters. I avoid involving myself in such bothersome affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: That is, unless you bring news about the sword.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: My older brother's sword. If I find it, I can finally give him a proper burial...

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: It's the only fitting way to go for a martial artist like him.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: It's a flat blade, sharp enough to slice an airborne hair in two. It's named "Unseen Razor."

choices.text: How did you become Master of the Liyue branch?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Ugh, why does everyone ask me the same question... I will make an exception for you, though, and give you the full story.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: I used to be a mercenary. I joined the Adventurers' Guild so I could take advantage of their superior intelligence network and track down the sword.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: I may not be very literate but I can read the word "sword." So I just took on every single commission that had something to do with a sword.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Then, just when I'd finished my eighth— Or was it my ninth commission? Anyway, I'd just finished it, and then word came from the headquarters in Snezhnaya that I'd apparently completed two S-rank commissions.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: ...And suddenly I found myself promoted to branch Guild Master. It was all very strange indeed.

choices.text: I'll let you know if I find anything.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Oh, thanks! I love meeting people like you who are up for everything.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: I am grateful to you, newcomer. It looks like it was worth me joining the Guild after all.
